verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents an official MCP path for coding agents with OAuth 2.1 authentication and tools to list services and run SQL. It also exposes the native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface for any CLI or driver, and CHKit offers typed commands to describe schema. Governance is covered by table- and column-level roles, full query logging of agent reads, and isolated read-only agent compute, so the loop runs end to end without a dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicit MCP or API schema-discovery tool (only listing services and CHKit 'describe' are documented), detail on how results are returned to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent workflow.
